notes: DiscoFlate v3.51.0 — the big one. ACTION BLOCKS become real trigger trees: variables ([var:x] session-wide, [uvar:x] per player, set/inc/dec/mult/div with arithmetic in any number field), if/otherwise with ALL/ANY condition groups, repeat (fixed count or until-conditions, capped), random with optional weights, label/goto/goto_if/group for jumps and retry loops, cancel to stop every other running block, and a per-row 'once' tickbox. OVERLAYS: a Device Timer List (primary pump on top, rows grow as you add devices — and secondary pumps now feed the same capacity gauge on their own calibration), a Timer overlay with start/stop actions plus auto-start and auto-vanish, a Poll Viewer that appears while a poll runs and holds the results, GREEN-SCREEN CHROMA KEY so a plain .mp4 plays over your camera with its background knocked out, scene groups to fire whole sets at once, explicit layer ordering, animate-and-fade with direction, and per-layer queueing so a rush of alerts plays one after another instead of stacking. Overlay actions now CALL overlays designed on the Stages tab rather than defining them inline, with overlay_kill and update_overlay_text. Chat tab reorganised: log on the left, buttons stacked in a panel on the right. Plus device rename (✏️), and per-device command pacing so cloud vendors can't be hammered — turning a device OFF is never delayed.
